benefits: 1. 50 % of cost of unit, subject to a maximum of ₹ 1,88,000/- per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of ₹ 2,28,000/- per unit for NE/SC/ST & 90% Spice Producer's Groups in Identified Clusters subjected to maximum of ₹ 3,38,000/- 1. Individual farmers having a minimum of 0.40 ha - 8 ha under turmeric are eligible to benefit under the scheme. 1. Assistance for groups/FPOs will be as in QGBG
detailed_description: The Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement – Turmeric Boiler (Nos.) is implemented by the Spices Board, India, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The scheme aims to encourage turmeric growers to adopt hygienic steam boiling units for processing turmeric, thereby improving the quality of the produce and making it suitable for export markets. By promoting modern post-harvest processing practices, the scheme helps enhance product quality, reduce contamination, and increase the export potential of Indian turmeric. The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
eligibility: 1.All turmeric growing States and regions/UT in India. 2. Designated Officials will conduct final inspection and recommend the eligible cases.
